## Change and Design Contract

Describe the problem, the chosen fix, and any change to observation, context,
coordinates, tool execution, or cancellation. Link an issue if applicable.

## Validation

List commands actually run and results. State what was not tested.

- [ ] Relevant regression tests added or existing coverage explained.
- [ ] Documentation matches any changed contract or safety boundary.
- [ ] No credentials, profiles, personal screenshots, or unreviewed logs included.
- [ ] No real desktop input or external model requests added to automated tests.
